name: Monterosa Ski
note: Gressoney, Ayas and Alagna, linked over two high cols.
operationsProvenance: PLACEHOLDER, carried over from the hand-typed graph this replaces. Must be replaced with published lift hours.
defaultBaseWhy: OSM writes it with one f. The config used to say Staffal, which matched nothing, so the app opened its default day at whichever base happened to be lowest.
cameraWhy: Set by eye to open looking up the Gressoney valley. The derivation from lowest base to high point gives -53, which looks up from Alagna instead.
toleranceWhy: Measured with npm run resort:tune. 20 of 25 lifts and 62 km survive at 75; 60 loses six kilometres and 45 collapses to ten lifts.
publishedSource: NOT RECORDED. The figures the app used before this resort had OSM data came from src/resort.js, which was hand-typed from memory and is not a source. Needs the resort's own published network figures or its PDF piste map.
